note: City of Lyons campground in Island Park, beside a Logan Creek oxbow on the west edge of town. Gravel sites with hookup pedestals; bathhouse on site. Municipal pool and fishing within walking distance. --Claude
summary: City page re-read 2026-11-05 (live, (c)2026): $25/night ($150/week, $500/30 days), FCFS no reservations, Apr 15-Oct 15, full hookups 30/50 A + dump, bathhouse - all confirmed as manual. Site count 14 is not on any city page: cleared. Not waterfront kept. Sites could not be located on imagery (both mosaics predate or hide the gravel strip in the city's photo); pin ~145 m from Google's point, no move. Note cleaned of the restated fields.
flags: SITES COUNT cleared (was 14, derived from old note prose): the city's page gives none.

PIN not located: stored 41.93487,-96.48050 is in the open lawn south of the oxbow (Esri and NAIP show grass with mown tracks there, no gravel); Google's 'Island Park Campground' point 41.93615,-96.48082 is ~145 m north on the tree-covered island inside the oxbow, where neither mosaic shows a gravel RV strip either. The city's photo shows a straight gravel strip with a row of pedestals beside a paved road, which matches neither spot on the (older) imagery. Under 250 m apart, so no move proposed; a human with current imagery could pin it.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the oxbow is a cut-off loop ~20-35 m wide around the island, roughly 2 acres of water on imagery (a pond under the ~5-acre line) and green with algae on NAIP; Logan Creek's live channel (~15-20 m wide) runs ~150-250 m west of either candidate camp spot, past the ball fields and park roads. Nothing supports a water value.
PHONE 402-687-2485 matches the City of Lyons footer (city hall); website correct. Google: 5.0 from 1 review (city campground; the private presence rule does not apply).
SAND: not applicable (gravel pads). FIT: no posted limit; full hookups 30/50 A.
